description: Rewrite AI-generated text with Rephrasy so it reads in a natural, human style — varying sentence rhythm, structure and word choice while preserving meaning. Returns the rewritten text. Costs words/credits on the connected Rephrasy plan.

language.description: Optional output language hint, e.g. "en", "de". Defaults to input language.

model.description: Rephrasy model to use. Default "v4" (recommended). "superstealth" is the newest model, built for the highest bypass rates and recommended against Pangram, but slower (10-60 s per request). "ft_clean-v3" retains meaning best and keeps the length almost identical — prefer it for technical text and anything with figures. Also available: "Undetectable Model", "SEO Model", or a Writing Style ID from your Rephrasy account to write in that voice.

name: humanize
title: Humanize text
